terms.comment: Our phrase: no reference work has a word for a playlist. Seriēs, a row of things one after another (Lewis & Short; Traupman 262 gives it for a string or a thread of messages), and cantus, a song (see song).

sources: Lewis & Short: series · Lewis & Short: cantus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 262.
No source has a word for a playlist.
